# ChronoForms fixtures

Used only by the import tests (`e2e-import.mjs`, `e2e-import7.mjs`). Not shipped.

- `demos.cf8bak`, `cf8-install.sql`: the demo forms and table definitions that ship with ChronoForms 8 (ChronoEngine.com, GNU GPL).
- `*.cf7bak`: the demo forms that ship with ChronoForms 7 (ChronoEngine.com, GNU GPL).

Some demos contain PHP actions. The tests check that none of it comes across into SquidForm.
